name: OpenVibe.Bench

exposure.note: the public home, /docs and the bench.* API at bench.openvibe.services since 2026-10-28; services on the host call 127.0.0.1:5230

liveness.means: the process is up and answers HTTP; it checks nothing else (the database and dependencies are what ready checks)

drains: outbox publisher stopped (its send in progress awaited; unsent rows stay for the next start)
telemetry buffer flushed and its retention timer stopped
open HTTP connections closed, then the server

resumes.what: rounds and private eval runs left queued or running are marked failed at boot; the caller retries them
unsent bench.round.finished, bench.judgement.recorded and bench.rating.changed events in the outbox go to OpenVibe.Events once the publisher starts
OpenVibe.Events redelivers network.account.export_requested and network.account.deleted that were pending during the stop; account_data_events applies each once

conditions: automatic: ovhost deploy puts the previous sha back and restarts again when the ready URL does not answer 2xx within ready.timeoutSeconds after the restart (exit 3)
rollback.window: automatic only while ovhost waits for readiness after the restart (30 s in host.example.json); manual afterwards, as long as no blocker applies

blockers.none: the schema code only adds (CREATE … IF NOT EXISTS, ADD COLUMN; no DROP, RENAME or table rebuild), which an older release ignores

leases.none: no claims: one process owns its PostgreSQL database (ov_bench); a round is taken with a compare-and-set on its status (queued → running)

notes: Port 5230, unit openvibe-bench.service, database ov_bench. The shared AI benchmark and comparison engine (plan 2026-10-28 §4.12): kinds, pinned rounds, entries, blind judgements, ratings, boards, the open dataset and private evals. AI stays the run authority, Report the analytics authority. Bench answers account export and deletion (ADR-033) and subscribes to the two account Events topics. It calls AI's run API (ai.run.create, namespace ai.generate) for generation and publishes bench.* events through its outbox. Stage B1 (spec 2026-10-30): the registry — versioned, forkable benchmarks (bench.benchmark@1) and the results API (bench.run@1), with compare, rankings and percentiles.
